reason: B speaks my language: it names tips, commissions, retail and staff paid different ways, and it spells out what I actually get each month. That helps me see what I'd get beyond what my cousin does at tax time, and the no-obligation, 'I'll tell you honestly if I'm a fit' call feels easy to book. A is honest and warm, but it reads more generally, and its paragraph about the price increase makes me focus on cost.
